grammar.explanation: 我也看足球，也跳舞 presents two included activities. It does not make the activities simultaneous. State the same subject clearly; distinguish preferences from performed actions.

examples.py: wǒ yě kàn zú qiú , yě tiào wǔ .
examples.en: I watch football and also dance.

examples.zh: 她也喜欢比赛，也喜欢慢慢练。
examples.py: tā yě xǐ huān bǐ sài , yě xǐ huān màn màn liàn .
examples.en: She likes competitions and also slow practice.

examples.py: tā yě xué hàn yǔ , yě xué rì yǔ .
examples.en: He studies Chinese and also Japanese.

commonMistakes.wrong: 也看足球，也跳舞说明同时做。
commonMistakes.right: 也看足球，也跳舞说明两项都有，不一定同时。
commonMistakes.why: Parallel inclusion does not establish simultaneity.

grammar.explanation: 又高兴又紧张 describes two co-occurring feelings. 又快又准 combines speed and accuracy in the stated action, not every future action. Do not replace negative uncertainty with an invented positive trait.

examples.py: tā yòu gāo xìng yòu jǐn zhāng .
examples.en: She is both happy and nervous.

examples.py: zhè cì dòng zuò yòu kuài yòu zhǔn .
examples.en: This movement is both fast and accurate.

examples.py: zhè duàn wǔ yòu qīng sōng yòu yǒu qù .
examples.en: This dance passage is both relaxed and interesting.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她又高兴又紧张，所以只高兴。
commonMistakes.right: 她又高兴又紧张，两种感受都有。

dialogue.title: The final is tomorrow
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 你是本场选手还是球迷？
lines.py: nǐ shì běn chǎng xuǎn shǒu hái shi qiú mí ?
lines.en: Are you a player in this game or a fan?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 球迷。我也看足球，也跳舞，但没有参加今天的比赛。
lines.py: qiú mí . wǒ yě kàn zú qiú , yě tiào wǔ , dàn méi yǒu cān jiā jīn tiān de bǐ sài .
lines.en: A fan. I watch football and dance, but am not competing today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 甲队领先，就算已经胜利了吧？
lines.py: jiǎ duì lǐng xiān , jiù suàn yǐ jīng shèng lì le ba ?
lines.en: Team A leads, so surely victory is already secured?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还没结束，决赛也在明天。排名要看本场规则。
lines.py: hái méi jié shù , jué sài yě zài míng tiān . pái míng yào kàn běn chǎng guī zé .
lines.en: It is not over; the final is tomorrow. Rankings depend on this event’s rules.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她得到银牌，为什么又高兴又紧张？
lines.py: tā dé dào yín pái , wèi shén me yòu gāo xìng yòu jǐn zhāng ?
lines.en: She got silver. Why both happy and nervous?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 高兴是这次的结果，紧张是想到下一场。两种都有。
lines.py: gāo xìng shì zhè cì de jié guǒ , jǐn zhāng shì xiǎng dào xià yī chǎng . liǎng zhǒng dōu yǒu .
lines.en: Happiness concerns this result; nervousness concerns the next game. Both occur.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: Why is the athlete both happy and nervous?
choices: The current result pleases her and the next game makes her nervous
She has already won every future game
questions.answer: The current result pleases her and the next game makes her nervous

reading.title: Read one result at a time
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 比赛里有选手和对手，球迷观看，三种角色不同。
lines.py: bǐ sài lǐ yǒu xuǎn shǒu hé duì shǒu , qiú mí guān kàn , sān zhǒng jué sè bù tóng .
lines.en: A competition has players and opponents, with fans watching; the three roles differ.

lines.zh: 金牌和银牌写在榜单上，这局胜了不表示下局也赢。
lines.py: jīn pái hé yín pái xiě zài bǎng dān shàng , zhè jú shèng le bù biǎo shì xià jú yě yíng .
lines.en: Gold and silver are on the list; winning this round does not mean winning the next.

lines.zh: 输了一局可以重新练，落后也按规则；领先不是永远胜利。
lines.py: shū le yī jú kě yǐ chóng xīn liàn , luò hòu yě àn guī zé ; lǐng xiān bù shì yǒng yuǎn shèng lì .
lines.en: After losing a round one can practise again; follow rules when behind; a lead is not permanent victory.

lines.zh: 足球、跳高和跳远记录不同，不能把高度和距离当同一成绩。
lines.py: zú qiú , tiào gāo hé tiào yuǎn jì lù bù tóng , bù néng bǎ gāo dù hé jù lí dāng tóng yī chéng jì .
lines.en: Football, high jump and long jump record different things; height and distance are not one result.

lines.zh: 她也跳舞，也游泳；游得快也先看现场许可，跳以前确认安全。
lines.py: tā yě tiào wǔ , yě yóu yǒng ; yóu de kuài yě xiān kàn xiàn chǎng xǔ kě , tiào yǐ qián què rèn ān quán .
lines.en: She dances and swims; even swimming fast requires local permission; confirm safety before jumping.

lines.zh: 胖玩具是她的纪念品，不用它评论人的身体。旧世界杯录像也不是今天的比赛。
lines.py: pàng wán jù shì tā de jì niàn pǐn , bù yòng tā píng lùn rén de shēn tǐ . jiù shì jiè bēi lù xiàng yě bù shì jīn tiān de bǐ sài .
lines.en: A plump toy is her souvenir, not a basis for commenting on bodies; old World Cup recordings are not today’s game.

choices: Roles, event formats and actual results
Every sport’s scores treated as one
